I good way to kill any dissatisfaction with linux (which should only exist if you havn't figured out your particular issue yet) is to find the things you can do on linux that you can't do on windows. Different system, different opportunities. Sieze them.

Like, for example on linux you can compile code so much easier now. Go to github and get the absolute newest of anything you want. You may run into snags but that some times happens with compiling. I promise, on windows you would end up with 50x the snags, hense you never did it. You never knew it was something that you wanted to do but now it's here.

That may sound esoteric but google all the time pops up with github links and with linux now you know you will have few snags using the info in the link.

But along the more immediate ease is the ability to install servers really easily. Try installing a mumble server. Just takes one line. sudo apt-get install mumble, done. Now you have essencially a team-speak server (you should still do some port forwarding on your router though).
